action.instructions: The words are a command for something this page does not show. Which one action would reveal it, or find it? Each option is a whole action: a numbered ref with what is done to it, or a verb that needs no ref. Choose none when the words are a remark or noise, nothing to look for.

options.navigate: go to a web address the words name: a website, a host or a url
options.search: search for the words: on the web, or on this site when they point at something on it
options.back: go back to the previous page
options.press: press a key: enter, escape, space or an arrow key
options.read: read the page aloud or show its contents
options.clear: clear the text in the focused field
options.stop: stop what the browser is doing
options.none: a remark or noise, nothing to look for
options.play: music: find a song or video by the words and play it now, on YouTube or on this site as the words point — never the page's play button, which is a click
options.play_next: music: find a song by the words and play it after the one playing
options.queue: music: find a song by the words and add it to the end of the queue
options.skip: music: skip to the next song
options.previous: music: go back to the song before
options.show: music: show the video playing on the screen
options.correct: music: the song playing is the wrong one: play the next result of its search instead
options.correct_back: music: play the result of the search before the song playing instead
options.forget: music: forget the song playing, so its words search again next time
options.resume: reopen the last page the screen showed: "YE - HIGHS AND LOWS - YouTube"

slot.instructions: Which words of the transcript are the thing the command carries verbatim: the address to open, the search terms, the song to play, the text to type, the key to press? Never the command word itself: "play X" carries X. A line with no command word, such as a question, carries itself: its search terms are the line as asked. Choose none when it carries none.

options.none: the command carries no words of its own

extent.instructions: Only when the action scrolls the page or a scrolling part of it: how far? Choose words when the words give a number of screens or pages; screen when they say nothing of how far. Ignored for every other action.

options.words: as many screens as the number the words carry
options.little: a little: a third of a screen
options.screen: one screen, as Page Down does
options.end: all the way: to the bottom, or to the top going up

outcome.instructions: Is what the user asked for done? First: if a pop-up, sign-in prompt or challenge covers the page now, choose in_the_way; a cookie strip or other notice on the page that covers nothing is not in the way. Otherwise judge by their words and Done so far, not by the page alone: choose yes when the page shows what they asked to see (for a question, when Text in view states its answer), or Done so far shows the action they asked for has happened; not_yet when more steps are needed.

options.yes: done: the page shows it or its answer, or the action they asked for has happened
options.in_the_way: a pop-up or prompt covers the page now
options.not_yet: not done: more to do, nothing covering the page
